sloka: क्रोशन्ती राम रामेति लक्ष्मणेति च विस्वरम् ।स्फुरन्ती रावणस्य अन्के पन्नगेन्द्र वधूः यथा ॥४-६-१०॥
transliteration: krośantī rāma rāmeti lakṣmaṇeti ca visvaram ।sphurantī rāvaṇasya anke pannagendra vadhūḥ yathā ॥4-6-10॥

translations.english: 'Yes, I remember. I had observed a lady being carried away by a wicked demon. She was crying loudly 'Oh, Rama Oh Rama Oh Lakshmana' in a husky voice. It was Maithili. She was wriggling on the lap of Ravana like a female serpent.
